description: This Java source file defines a global exception handler for a Spring-based REST API. It handles specific exceptions like ProductNotFoundException, validation errors, and generic exceptions, returning minimal JSON responses with standardized structure including timestamp, code, and message.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring @ControllerAdvice class that handles various exceptions globally across the application, generating structured JSON error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ProductNotFoundException, returning a 404 response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from invalid method arguments, returning a 400 response with validation error details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 response with the exception message.

methods.name: baseBody
methods.description: Constructs the standard response body containing timestamp, code, and message.
